title: MAI Code 2 is in Copilot. The discount is promotional.
friendlyTitle: Microsoft's new coding model is in Copilot. The low price is a sale.
summary: Microsoft released MAI Code 2 and the cheaper Code 2 Flash for everyday coding. Both are in GitHub Copilot. Flash is also in a limited preview in Microsoft Foundry. On four coding tests, Microsoft says Code 2 reached 98% of GPT-6.1 Sol's score at 40% of the cost, and 96% of Claude Opus 5.5's score at 5% of the cost. Those costs use a 50% promotional price.
friendlySummary: Microsoft released two coding models, Code 2 and the cheaper Code 2 Flash. Both are in GitHub Copilot. Flash is also in a limited preview in Microsoft Foundry. Microsoft says Code 2 came close to two leading models on four coding tests, at a much lower price. That price uses a 50% sale.
whyItMatters: Microsoft says the models are not yet tuned for science research or very long agent jobs. The average pass rate on its four-test mix was 63.2%, against 64.1% for GPT-6.1 Sol, at $0.309 a task versus $0.761. A cheaper patch is still a patch. Read the diff before you merge it.
